A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same DND research work, with 17 pages and complete Appendices A–F. Text and rendered-page comparison establish that all pages except 1 and 5 are identical, with no material reading gaps.

before.justification: v2 reports original dense and MoE model evaluations in Tables 1–2, measured throughput in Table 3, ablations in Table 4, and token-selection analyses in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains these original benchmark, throughput, ablation, and token-selection results, including the supplementary analyses and examples in Appendices D–E.

M1.justification: For selected tokens, Equation (4) changes fusion from βp_i x_v + (1−βp_i)x_d to βp_i x_d + (1−βp_i)x_v. This locally corrects the specified fusion rule to match the existing prose and Figure 2; the PDFs do not establish a changed implementation or rerun.

E1.justification: The SFT data description and evaluated knowledge/alignment, mathematics/STEM, and coding/agent benchmarks are unchanged. No dataset, domain, or test scenario is added or removed in the main text or appendices.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains the same vanilla SFT comparisons and ITT comparison for Qwen3-1.7B. Table 2 retains the same vanilla MoE SFT and Qwen3 reference models, and Table 4 retains the same ablation comparators.

E3.justification: The reported model configurations, training budgets, evaluation metrics, and throughput procedures in Section 4 and Appendix B are identical. No evaluation-protocol revision is reported alongside the fusion-equation correction.

E4.justification: Table 4 retains the router/threshold-control, selection-ratio, and layer-range ablations. Section 4.5 and Appendices D–E retain the same entropy, routing stability, hidden-state, and qualitative token-selection analyses.

E5.justification: Appendix B specifies the same 16 inferences per AIME24 question and averaged accuracy. Repeated-run information, plotted uncertainty displays, and statistical reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: All reported numerical results, plotted findings, and qualitative examples are identical. For example, Tables 1–2 retain the average DND gains of 1.88 points for Qwen3-1.7B and 0.87 points for Qwen3-30B-A3B.

T1.justification: Equation (4) corrects the mathematical definition of the fused hidden state by exchanging which representation receives each coefficient. This changes the formula's meaning rather than merely its notation. The remaining equations and Appendix A's computational-overhead derivation are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: selective nested computation, router and threshold control, post-training integration into dense and MoE models, and performance gains with limited overhead.

C2.justification: The fusion explanation is unchanged; v3 corrects the equation to match it. Token-selection interpretations in Section 4.5 and Appendices D–E, and applicability limitations and future directions in Appendix F, are also unchanged.

D1.justification: Section 4.2 and Appendix B retain the same data description, hyperparameters, initialization, optimizer settings, hardware, and training times. Both versions still state that code will be released soon.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning are identical, including the comparisons with ITT and MOR in Section 2 and Appendix C/Table 6. The added acceptance note does not revise the relationship to prior research.

P1.justification: v3 adds 'Accepted by ICLR 2026' to the first-page footnote and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. The narrative wording and section structure otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–10, Tables 1–6, captions, and placements are unchanged. The equation correction and first-page text updates do not reorganize the page layout or alter any figure or table display.

improvement.justification: v3 resolves the inconsistency between Equation (4) and the existing fusion explanation and Figure 2 by assigning βp_i to the nested output. This modestly improves internal consistency and makes the method easier to implement faithfully. The experimental evidence and appendices remain unchanged, so the benefit is limited to the corrected specification.
